scope: Daily candidates only; no formal catalog admission

sources.title: FAST-LIVO2: Fast, Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
sources.reading_depth: Selected sections V-B, V-E, VI, VII, IX-A and sequential-update discussion; not independently reproduced
sources.evidence_boundary: Geometry is built from LiDAR; image photometric updates constrain state. Default normal refinement is off. This brief does not claim visual densification of the map.

sources.title: Dense-depth map guided deep Lidar-Visual Odometry with Sparse Point Clouds and Images
sources.reading_depth: Selected methods III-A/III-D/III-E, experiments IV and conclusion; not independently reproduced
sources.evidence_boundary: Table IV on KITTI 09-10 reports translation 3.26% for sparse-depth input and 0.96% for completed depth. Sparse baseline fills missing depth with a default value. Trained on 00-08; does not validate quadruped deployment or integration into FAST-LIVO2.

sources.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
sources.reading_depth: Selected methods, matched RGB-only comparison in Table 2, appendices C.8 and D.3-D.4 and limitations; not independently reproduced
sources.evidence_boundary: Same training steps do not establish equal compute. Test trajectories share robots and labs with training. Depth reference is learned stereo reconstructed through the VAE. No closed-loop success-rate gain is established.

sources.title: 3D Lidar Reconstruction with Probabilistic Depth Completion for Robotic Navigation
sources.reading_depth: Official abstract and fulltext identity/section overview; not a full method audit
sources.evidence_boundary: Historical probabilistic depth-completion and mapping reference; not proof that completed geometry improves LIO pose estimation.
